name: authoring-v5
description: v0.8 update: same corpus and split assignments as v4; system prompt gains rule 7 (no recursive self-call). Rule 7 addresses the pyjwt canary failure where v0.7 generated HMACAlgorithm.prepare_key calling self.prepare_key() (infinite recursion). No new bundles added — v0.8 tests whether cross-language simplify/replace signal (grub2 C examples) generalises to Python at the adapter level, and whether rule 7 suppresses the recursive-call failure.

zlib.reason: CVE-2022-37434: classic C heap over-read (gzip header state). Single-hunk inflate.c guard; the canonical source-backport shape. Tests condition-refine pattern.

bzip.reason: CVE-2026-42250: C bounds fix in bzip2recover.c. Tight single-file change; tests the model on a minimal off-by-one-class guard (1-line-tweak pattern).

pythonPackages.requests.reason: CVE-2024-47081: Python credential-leak fix (netrc host matching). Tests simplify/replace pattern (replace ri.netloc.split with ri.hostname).

pythonPackages.pyjwt.reason: CVE-2026-48526: Python algorithm-confusion fix (reject JWK-as-HMAC-secret in prepare_key). Tests add-guard-block in specific subclass method plus rule 7 (no recursive self-call).

pythonPackages.nltk.reason: CVE-2026-33236: Python path-traversal via malicious catalog. Fix adds inline path guard (detect-and-reject shape). Forced to train to teach inline-guard pattern.

pythonPackages.python-jose.reason: CVE-2024-33664: Python JWE unbounded input — fix adds size check at decrypt() entry. Second detect-and-reject Python example. Forced to train to reinforce pyjwt canary pattern.

pythonPackages.python-multipart.reason: CVE-2026-40347: Python HTTP multipart header parsing fix. Dev example for mixed-language eval signal. Preserved from v4.

pythonPackages.pygments.reason: CVE-2026-4539: Python lexer-safe regex (pygments ReDoS backport). Second Python dev example. Preserved from v4.

grub.reason: CVE-2024-45781 + CVE-2024-45782: two grub2 simplify/replace examples (grub_strcpy -> grub_strlcpy). grub naturally hashes to dev; forced to train to add simplify/replace fix-pattern examples.

note: v5 = v4 split assignments + rule 7 in system prompt. No new corpus entries. Rule 7: never introduce a recursive self-call; add guard logic as new statements at the top of the existing method body. Expect: train=88, dev=6, canary=4 (same counts as v4 after re-export).
